text: Public administration is an interdisciplinary subject that takes the governance of the government, non-profit organizations and public sectors as its research objects. It integrates knowledge from fields such as political science, economics, sociology and law, aiming to cultivate compound talents with the ability to analyze public policies, manage organizations and innovate public services. The professional objective is to enable students to master the core logic of "how to efficiently allocate public resources, solve social problems, and optimize the governance system", and to be able to engage in decision-making, management and service work in government agencies, public institutions, ngos (non-profit organizations) and public affairs departments of enterprises.
